description: What does DROP TABLE return for a table that an open recordset reads inside the level, and what does that recordset hold after Rollback? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0). BeginTrans; open dynaset rs on S, MoveFirst; DROP TABLE S (dbFailOnError); DBEngine.Errors; catalog; read the row of rs; Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; rs.MoveFirst and read its row; read SELECT ID, V, K, N FROM S; close; catalog and S through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
